findings.evidence: FullSubquiver.lean:82–83 uses Subtype.ext solely to reflect endpoint equality; Basic.lean:86 does the same to reflect composability. Replacing these with hF gives the general proofs; the remaining arguments already use induced operations and totalHomMap.
findings.fix: Prove the projection, injectivity, degree-reflection, operation-intertwining, and strict-map results for InducedQuiver C F with hF : Function.Injective F; derive the full-subcategory construction from them. Generalize homProjection_totalHomMap_of_not at line 89 to endpoints outside Set.range F.
findings.issue: homProjection_totalHomMap, totalHomMap_injective, and totalHomMap_mem_totalGrading_piece_iff only support Subtype.val, preventing their use for general injective F. The same restriction affects totalHomMap_fullSubcategory_m and fullSubcategoryInclusion in AInfinity/FullSubcategory/Basic.lean:70–101.

summary: The remaining full-subquiver API is unnecessarily restricted to subtype inclusions; its proofs apply to arbitrary injective object maps.
